channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Wilt Chamberlain | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Wilt Chamberlain from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Hakeem Olajuwon, Wilt Chamberlain
item.description:
Karl-Anthony Towns:

“I think Hakeem. And I feel like in a way he kind of is like mythical like Wilt Chamberlain. Like, you know, but we have something to watch Hakeem games on, but like it's kind of like that same mythical creature like Wilt, but I've been able to talk and meet Hakeem and he's an amazing human. So I'm very honored to say that.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Hakeem Olajuwon, Wilt Chamberlain, Oct 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Sam Cassell on Wilt Chamberlain, Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Celtics assistant coach Sam Cassell on the Jaylen Brown trade:

“Jaylen has done everything possible for this city. He’ll be missed. But it’s the NBA. Wilt Chamberlain got traded after he averaged 50 points one year…I wish nothing but the best for Jaylen. He’s a hell of a basketball player.”

Sam Cassell on Wilt Chamberlain, Jaylen Brown, Jul 3, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Pat Riley on Wilt Chamberlain
item.description:
Riley said of the criticism.

“It really is. Anybody who is negative on it, anybody who was cynical about it, anybody who talked about it the way they talked about it in a negative way, they’re trying to either get views, hits, or they’re podcasters and that’s their job.“There are critics today that are just so unjustified in what was going on with the tactics, and we were fouled, and they were fouled. The same thing happened with Wilt Chamberlain when he got 100 back in the day. But I don’t buy any of that. They took an iconic, absolute incredible performance, and they tried to dismiss it. And that’s not fair.”

Pat Riley on Wilt Chamberlain, Mar 14, 2026. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Wilt Chamberlain
item.description:
“I think he can definitely play still in this era. [Watching Chamberlain's highlights] was just to see how he's faster, bigger, and stronger than everybody else and still a talent. So, I think he could still play in this era.”

Nikola Jokic on Wilt Chamberlain, Mar 9, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Wilt Chamberlain
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't:Kevin Durant:

“Wilt Chamberlain is somebody I studied and try to look up as much as I can on a player like that. He set a standard for NBA players and grateful to reach that and inspired by what he produced to the game of basketball. Portland is such a classy, classy city for recognizing me in that moment and honoring me”

Kevin Durant on Wilt Chamberlain, Jan 10, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Dominique Wilkins on Michael Jordan, Wilt Chamberlain, Bill Russell
item.description:
Dominique Wilkins:

“I don’t believe in the GOAT and all that stuff. How can you say a guy is the greatest of all-time when they haven’t played against some of the guys that were the greatest of their era? Like a Wilt Chamberlain, Bill Russell. “But I will say this: Michael Jordan made six Finals and won six championships with the same team. And he won three championships after retiring to play another sport. Nothing like that has ever been done before. MJ did some things that no one will ever do. So if I’m going with the best player to ever play, that’s where my mindset sits. I’m going with Michael. That’s no disrespect to anybody, but I’m looking at what he accomplished in a short period of time.”

Dominique Wilkins on Michael Jordan, Wilt Chamberlain, Bill Russell, Jun 2, 2025. Source: Esports Insider.

item.title: Oscar Robertson on Wilt Chamberlain, Bill Russell
item.description:
Oscar Robertson:

“Wilt Chamberlain was putting on a show for people. He carried the NBA for years, and I’ve always said this: the year he averaged 50 points a game, my good friend Bill Russell won MVP because they won the championship. But when you average 50 points in a season and I average a triple-double that same year, it’s unbelievable. And people don’t say much about it.”

Oscar Robertson on Wilt Chamberlain, Bill Russell, Sep 19, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Julius Erving on Jerry West, Oscar Robertson, Elgin Baylor, Wilt Chamberlain, Bill Russell
item.description:
In an interview with Joy DeAngela,Julius Erving named the top 10 players he thinks are the best in basketball history.

“I have five guys who are untouchable - Bill Russell, Wilt Chamberlain, Oscar Robertson, Jerry West, and Elgin Baylor.,”

Julius Erving on Jerry West, Oscar Robertson, Elgin Baylor, Wilt Chamberlain, Bill Russell, Jul 30, 2023. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Michael Malone on Wilt Chamberlain, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Michael Malone on Nikola Jokic:

“That first Summer League in Vegas, 300 pounds, out of shape, hey, he's a nice player. No one, and if anybody tells you different they're full of shit,no one could have seen that he'd be a two-time MVP passing Wilt Chamberlain every other night.”

Michael Malone on Wilt Chamberlain, Nikola Jokic, May 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Jeff Green on Wilt Chamberlain, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Jeff Green on Nikola Jokic passing Wilt Chamberlain in career triple-doubles:

“It’s an incredible list to be on, especially given how he started his career.”

Jeff Green on Wilt Chamberlain, Nikola Jokic, Nov 5, 2022. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Wilt Chamberlain, Daniel Gafford
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Kyle Kuzma on Daniel Gafford:

“I call him Wilt Chamberlain sometimes. He just be blocking shit for no reason.”

Kyle Kuzma on Wilt Chamberlain, Daniel Gafford, Nov 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry, Wilt Chamberlain
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Steph Curry, who's 19 points away from breaking Wilt Chamberlain's franchise scoring record:

“Passing Wilt in anything statistically is sort of remarkable. ... The fact that Steph is about to break that record is just incredible.”

Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry, Wilt Chamberlain, Apr 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Julius Erving on Kobe Bryant, Wilt Chamberlain, Bill Russell
item.description:
“A couple occasions I’ve been in the same room, chatted a little bit. But like Kobe Bryant situation, he’s another generation, or in some cases multiple generations removed from me in terms of my playing days. I’m more of a father figure or even a grandfather figure to those guys who are playing now. And I accept that. I looked at Bill Russell and Wilt Chamberlain in that regard. These are the giants of the game. I made it my mission to chase that bar. It’s very high.”

Julius Erving on Kobe Bryant, Wilt Chamberlain, Bill Russell, Feb 27, 2020. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar on LeBron James, Wilt Chamberlain
item.description:
Kareem:

“I got a chance to know Wilt Chamberlain and, I'm not trying to knock him, but he kind of lived above it all. Once he made it, he didn't feel obliged to try to make it easier for those who hadn't made it. LeBron's attitude is a lot different and I really appreciate that.”

Kareem Abdul-Jabbar on LeBron James, Wilt Chamberlain, Mar 14, 2019. Source: Twitter @AlexKennedyNBA.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Wilt Chamberlain
item.description:
“To me, you got Wilt Chamberlain. He’s got all the records, and no one is ever gonna beat them. I don’t see anyone ever getting 100 points in a game. That’s it, he’s the G.O.A.T.”

Joel Embiid on Wilt Chamberlain, Feb 26, 2019. Source: news.com.au.

item.title: LeBron James on Wilt Chamberlain
item.description:
Ryan Ward:LeBron James on Wilt Chamberlain:

“One of the most dominant forces in our game along with Shaq. One of the greatest #Lakers to ever play the game.”

LeBron James on Wilt Chamberlain, Nov 15, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: LaVar Ball on LeBron James, Shaquille O'Neal, Wilt Chamberlain
item.description:
LaVar Ball:

“The best playing in the NBA right now? Come on man. I’m biased. The best in the game right now is LeBron James. LeBron James is the best on the fact he’s stronger than everybody. It’s whoever is the biggest and strongest at that time. Like Wilt Chamberlain, he was stronger and faster than everybody. Shaquille O’Neal, same thing.”

LaVar Ball on LeBron James, Shaquille O'Neal, Wilt Chamberlain, Aug 4, 2018. Source: Lonzo Wire.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Wilt Chamberlain
item.description:
“I had another year after that and I only had to average 10 points because I wanted to pass up Wilt Chamberlain [on the all-time scoring list],”

Shaquille O'Neal on Wilt Chamberlain, Feb 14, 2016. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Wilt Chamberlain, All Star Game
item.description:
“Meeting Wilt Chamberlain in Cleveland [1997], Kobe's first All-Star Game in New York ['98],'03 in Atlanta because it was close to home and I had a bunch of friends and family that I hadn't seen, Jordan's last All-Star Game -- those are some of the ones that stand out,”

Kevin Garnett on Wilt Chamberlain, All Star Game, Feb 15, 2013. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Dwight Howard on Wilt Chamberlain, Bill Russell
item.description:
Abdul-Jabbar showed Howard a championship ring and gave him a jersey.

“He told me I had athleticism like Wilt Chamberlain and Bill Russell,”

Dwight Howard on Wilt Chamberlain, Bill Russell, Oct 24, 2012. Source: SI.com.

item.title: Bill Russell on Wilt Chamberlain
item.description:
Jeff Zillgitt:Bill Russell on Wilt Chamberlain:

“I'm going to tell you something. He could do that on anybody.”

Bill Russell on Wilt Chamberlain, Mar 3, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Oscar Robertson on Michael Jordan, Jerry West, Elgin Baylor, Wilt Chamberlain, Bill Russell
item.description:
Robertson told the Dan Sileo Show on WDAE in Tampa Wednesday morning.

“Let me tell you about what being great is. Ever hear of Elgin Baylor? Never mention his name, do we? Great basketball player. You know what you have today? Michael Jordan was a great player, but he won after Chicago got Pippen, Grant and those other players to go along with him, because for a while they couldn’t beat Detroit.“Everybody looks at what you’ve done. Sure he won six championships, Russell won eleven. There are other players on these teams when they play. They don’t play by themselves. Michael Jordan is a great player. Was he the greatest? Ask Kobe that. Ask Bill Russell. Ask Oscar Robertson. Ask Wilt Chamberlain. Ask Elgin Baylor, Jerry West, ask those guys.”

Oscar Robertson on Michael Jordan, Jerry West, Elgin Baylor, Wilt Chamberlain, Bill Russell, Jun 8, 2011. Source: Sporting News.
